changelog:
agent-orchestrator v1.0.0

- Initial public release with core multi-agent orchestration for complex task decomposition and execution.
- Added task decomposition, sub-agent spawning, parallel and sequential coordination, and synthesis of results.
- File-based communication assumed; removed deep-dive documentation and internal sub-agent templates.
- Provided extensive quick-start, architecture diagrams, configuration options, and real-world use cases.
- Included troubleshooting, error handling, and best-practices documentation.
- Open source under MIT-0; available on GitHub.
summary: Multi-agent collaboration and task orchestration. Decompose complex tasks, spawn sub-agents, coordinate execution, and synthesize results.
